disclaimer: Geometric upper-hemisphere sky visibility fraction (Omega_sky / 2pi) computed from 16-azimuth ray-marching within the local 10 km x 10 km Mars 2020 DEM. Does NOT equal percentage dose reduction: high-energy GCR ions penetrate rock scarps and generate secondary neutrons/albedo radiation in regolith, and terrain outside the local DEM footprint is not included.
